title: gqlX
tagline: gqlX: building NFT-native music-making experience for music3-makers.  Tokenizing everything from your samples to DAW plug-ins  into NFTs.
how_its_made: I use NFTPort for deploying the contract on Polygon and React.js as front-end. For the DAW part, I used an online library https://github.com/gridsound/daw. (unfortunately, this part is still under working and not included into the source code)                                                                                                                                      --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
